result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks it or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a renamed-aspect config.

The change is in `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It no longer uses the five fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals. For each of the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order, it now:
- gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose text files;
- reads that file from `data/text` and adds it to the zip under the same name.

With the default configuration the entries are the same five names in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment` as the aspect name, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written after `all_files.zip` as before, so it follows when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I also added the import for `NamedSourceCodeAspect`.
